Name: Upgraded Greenhouse assets
Author: Zinnalynn
Description:
This is a replacement folder to work with the wonderful [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30219]Greenhouse[/url] Upgrade mod made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/90329238]TheWariorGW[/url]! 

You [b]MUST[/b] have their mod for this to work.
With these maps, you gain two new rooms instead of one bigger room! The first upgrade adds a nice grassy room. You can hoe the ground for planting more crops, or plant trees, or anything else you might like. The second upgrade adds another room that has water flowing at the top, perfect for planting rice shoots out of season if you'd like, with nice spaces for the plants that require a trellis. 

[b]WARNING[/b]: If you have already been using their mod when you find this, and have the greenhouse unlocked, do note that whatever you have planted will be very misplaced!

To install:
After downloading the file here, go to your SDV mods folder, and locate the folder called [b]GreenhouseRobinUp.[/b]
Click into the folder, and then click into the [b][CP] GreenhouseRobinUpMaps.
[/b]Then you simply replace the [b]assets[/b] folder with the downloaded one.

When you get to upgrading, it's possible that SMAPI will have some red text, but don't worry! It's just because the way I chose to make my upgraded maps. There is a check that fails because it's not applicable, but it shouldn't break anything.
